_about: Do-Not-Translate registry for ms-MY. tokens = single words/acronyms;
phrases = multi-word proper names (product family, series titles). Both are
held verbatim: the drafting prompt forbids translating them and the gate
counts each entry EN-vs-candidate, flagging any loss as a hard reason.
Gap history: 'AI+ Everyone' was translated to 'AI+ Semua Orang' in v3 ch08
because the product family was not listed (caught by the blind panel).
Extend phrases with each new book's catalogue titles.
